assessment.nobel_worthiness: Halide perovskites turned a defect-tolerant, solution-processed semiconductor into a photovoltaic absorber that went from about 4% to well over 25% certified efficiency in little over a decade. The underlying physics (large absorption, long carrier diffusion lengths, unusual defect tolerance) is clear and quantitatively demonstrated, and the opportunity it opens, cheap tandem and thin-film photovoltaics and optoelectronics, is exactly the kind of new capability the prize can explain to a broad audience.
assessment.attribution: Miyasaka made the first perovskite-sensitized cell (2009). Park's 2011-2012 work and the solid-state Park/Gratzel and Snaith/Miyasaka devices established the thin-film solid-state architecture and the efficiency jump. Gratzel, Kanatzidis and Seok are also credible. I would cite the originator plus the two groups that made the solid-state breakthrough, but the split among Miyasaka, Park, Snaith, Gratzel and Seok is genuinely contested and would need committee work.
assessment.maturity: Independent confirmation is overwhelming and the field is huge, so recognition is not premature. The remaining caveat is operational stability and lead toxicity, which affect commercial maturity, but they do not undermine the discovery itself.
uncertainties: Contested allocation of credit among six credited names
Long-term stability and lead content could make a citation framed around practical impact premature
Exact dates and relative contributions of the 2009-2012 papers are from memory and not verified

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Reading single DNA or RNA molecules electrically through a nanopore is a physical measurement of ionic current blockades resolving individual nucleotides. It started as a bold idea and became a commercial long-read sequencing technology and a general single-molecule sensing platform. As a nanophysicist I find the principle clear, quantitative and generative.
assessment.attribution: Kasianowicz, Brandin, Branton and Deamer demonstrated single-strand detection (1996); Branton and Deamer had the original concept, Bayley engineered protein pores, and Akeson showed enzyme-controlled ratcheting that made sequencing practical. Three of the five credited names (Branton, Deamer, Akeson) capture concept and ratchet motion, but Bayley's pore engineering is arguably decisive and I am unsure of the current status of some of these individuals, which matters for a prize configuration.
assessment.maturity: The technology is mature and widely used, with independent confirmation, including in genomics and pathogen surveillance, so recognition is timely.
uncertainties: Whether Bayley's protein-pore engineering should displace one of the proposed names
Possible eligibility issues of deceased candidates; I cannot verify this
Whether the committee views this as chemistry or as analytical physics and sequencing technology

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Biomolecular condensates formed by liquid-liquid phase separation offer a new physical-chemical principle of intracellular organization, linking polymer physics, multivalency and cell biology. The concept has changed how people think about membraneless organelles and disease, and it is highly generative.
assessment.attribution: Hyman and Brangwynne showed liquid-like P granules (2009) and Rosen showed multivalent-interaction-driven phase separation (2012). Pappu and Mittag supply the physical-chemical framework. The three proposed are the most plausible core, but the weight of the theory contribution remains unclear.
assessment.maturity: The concept is widely adopted, but debate continues over which cellular structures are truly phase separated and over functional significance in vivo, so interpretation is still evolving and the timing could be early.
uncertainties: Ongoing debate about physiological relevance versus in vitro droplets
Chemistry versus physiology and medicine prize fit
Credit for theory (Pappu, Mittag) versus experiment

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Ionizable lipid nanoparticles are the delivery chemistry that enabled siRNA drugs and the mRNA COVID-19 vaccines, an enormous and clearly demonstrated impact built on a physical-chemistry principle: charge-switching lipids that assemble with nucleic acids and release them at endosomal pH.
assessment.attribution: Cullis's group built the formulation methods and early ionizable-lipid LNPs with Hope and Madden. Anderson, Langer and MacLachlan contributed lipid discovery, siRNA formulations and translation. Attribution is shared across academia and industry and is tangled with Medicine 2023 (Kariko and Weissman) and patent disputes.
assessment.maturity: Clinical proof at global scale is unequivocal. The question is the chemistry basis for a distinct citation after the 2023 Medicine prize.
uncertainties: Overlap with the 2023 Medicine prize
Disputed credit between academic and industrial inventors
Which lipid-design innovation was decisive is uncertain to me

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Base editors chemically convert one DNA base to another without double-strand breaks by fusing deaminases to a programmable Cas protein. It is an elegant molecular-engineering concept that opened precise correction of point mutations and has reached clinical trials.
assessment.attribution: Komor, Gaudelli and Liu developed cytosine and adenine base editors, with the senior intellectual direction from Liu, and Nishida and Kondo made an independent early cytidine-deaminase fusion. A single-laureate configuration is cleanest but may understate the first-author contributions.
assessment.maturity: Rapid adoption and first clinical results are strong, but the long-term safety and the shorter track record, and the 2020 prize on CRISPR-Cas9, argue that this is somewhat early.
uncertainties: Early clinical record is thin
Relationship to the CRISPR prize of 2020
Whether it should be grouped with prime editing (B064)

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Heterobifunctional degraders and molecular glues hijack the ubiquitin-proteasome system to remove target proteins, a new pharmacological principle that expands what is druggable. The chemical-biology logic is clear and widely generative.
assessment.attribution: Crews and Deshaies invented the PROTAC concept (2001), Ciulli's work on VHL ligands and structure-guided design was influential, and Handa with Ito identified cereblon as the thalidomide target. The credit has distinct strands, concept versus molecular-glue mechanism.
assessment.maturity: Clinical trials are advanced and the field is large, but no approved heterobifunctional degrader yet; recognition could be somewhat early.
uncertainties: No approved PROTAC drug yet
Splitting concept credit from glue mechanism credit
My knowledge of the clinical status may be outdated

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Imaging the internal bond structure of single molecules with a CO-functionalized tip in noncontact AFM is a striking, quantitative physical measurement that resolves chemical structure and bond order directly, and it has been used to follow on-surface reactions. It is conceptually clear and visually compelling.
assessment.attribution: Giessibl's qPlus sensor was the enabling instrument; Gross, Meyer and colleagues at IBM Zurich achieved submolecular resolution (2009). Eigler and Ho are famous for STM manipulation and spectroscopy and are less central to this specific discovery.
assessment.maturity: Well reproduced across many laboratories. Its impact on mainstream chemistry is narrower than that of the more applied candidates, so it is mature but less broadly transformative.
uncertainties: Breadth of impact across chemistry
Credit between instrument developers and imaging demonstration

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Car-Parrinello molecular dynamics unified electronic structure and dynamics, enabling first-principles simulation of liquids, solids and reactions with a clear, elegant physical idea. It underlies ab initio molecular dynamics and has strong lasting influence on computational chemistry and materials science.
assessment.attribution: A two-person prize with unambiguous credit: the 1985 PRL paper by Car and Parrinello. This is the cleanest attribution of any candidate on the list.
assessment.maturity: The method is four decades old and extensively validated and extended, so it is fully mature; the risk is that the committee sees it as long overdue or already overshadowed by the DFT prize of 1998 and by machine-learned potentials.
uncertainties: Overlap with Kohn and Pople DFT prize of 1998
Relationship with metadynamics (B014) and machine-learned potentials (B027) sharing Parrinello
Prize ordering and possible Parrinello double-listing
